source.section: Omega hand-off additions, items 6 (Typed results) and 7 (Read-back)
source.sha256_of: line 1179, a newline, then line 1180, without a trailing newline
text: 6. **Typed results.** `approval_required`: checkpoint the run, surface `approve_url`, poll `poll_url`, then retry the same call with `_meta["io.futureagi/approval_id"]`. `auth_required`: show `connect_url` to the user (URL-mode elicitation where supported). `tool_rate_limited`: retry after `retry_after_s`. `tool_budget_exhausted` and `agentcc_agent_budget` map to `OmegaSpendBudgetExceededError` (`spend-budget.ts:1397`); `managed_credits_*` and `managed_billing_unavailable` stay tool errors (BPC#24's rule applied to tools).

7. **Read-back.** Each result's `_meta["io.futureagi/tool_call"] {tool_call_id, executed, billing_mode (byok | managed), billed_usd, latency_ms}` (written by M15's `evidenceMeta`, chain step 20, on results and denials alike) and `["io.futureagi/budget"]` feed Omega's telemetry and, in phase 2, its spend ledger (`reportsBilledCost` for tool calls, as §10.8 does for models).
source.text_is: lines 1179 and 1180 verbatim, so MCP_PLAN=none (CI, without the plan file) still extracts the names from them

extraction: every backticked token on line 1179 that is snake_case, optionally ending in *: ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\*?$
every io.futureagi/<key> on lines 1179 and 1180: io\.futureagi/[a-z_]+
the comma-separated field list in the braces after io.futureagi/tool_call"] on line 1180, with parenthesised enums removed
